title: Finite monomial expansion of a binary form
statement: Let n∈ℕ and let Q∈BinaryForm ℂ n. For r∈Fin(n+1), define d_r:Fin 2→₀ℕ by d_r=single 0 r.val+single 1 (n−r.val), so d_r(0)=r.val and d_r(1)=n−r.val. Then, as an equality in MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ, Q.val=Σ_{r∈Fin(n+1)} coeff d_r(Q.val) • monomial d_r 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), Q.val = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) Q.val • MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) (1 : ℂ)
